task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to go to the east. With that over with, head north. Once you accomplish that, make an effort to venture west. Next, take a trip north. And then, attempt to go north. And then, go east. Then, make an effort to head south. With that accomplished, venture east. Then, pick-up the cashew from the floor of the recreation zone. Got that? Good!
